column3: With respect to the Northshore Mall Mortgage Loan (1.3%), the related borrower may, without the consent of the related lender, (i) make transfers of immaterial or non-income producing portions of the property to any government entity in connection with takings or condemnations of any portion of the related Mortgaged Property for dedication or public use, (ii) make transfers of non-income producing or vacant portions of the property to third parties or borrower
